lines.en: : What time is it?
I roll out of bed and clumsily reach for my phone on the end table and confirm that I've woken up significantly later than normal today.
It’s almost 10:00AM and I haven’t even gotten out of bed yet.
Normally, Ami would barge in and prevent me from sleeping in like this, but...I guess she has other things to do today?
What gives?
I would have invested in an alarm clock if I knew my [niece] would be this unreliable.
That’s right. This is all her fault.
I should go give her a piece of my mind.
I walk out into the living room only to be met with another horrible reality.
Breakfast isn’t ready either.
Is Ami dead?
That is the only possible thing I could think of given these circumstances.
: Ami, are you dead?
: Oh, Sensei is finally up!
Oh. I guess Ayane is over.
I mean, that at least kind of explains the lack of an alarm or breakfast...but I’m still not entirely convinced.
: Sensei! Come in and hang out with us!
: What? Wait a second! Don’t you dare-
I decide to do what any sane man would do and barge into my [niece]’s room despite her plea for privacy.
After all, Ayane said I could enter. So it’s not like I’m in the wrong or anything.
I just need to confirm that Ami isn’t in trouble. She should be thanking me.
: Oh.
: Sensei! What the heck?! I was trying to tell you to not come in!
: But...Ayane said I could.
: Of course I did! I wanted you to see my swimsuit! Super cute, right?
: Yeah, you look great Ayane.
: Uhhhhhh...
: Leave?
: Morning, Maya.
: “Morning, Maya?” Are you kidding me right now?
: Um...Sensei...I don’t...think you should be looking at her when she’s changing...
: Morning, Sana.
: Um...morning...
: See, Maya? Totally normal. Just a standard greeting exchanged between two people in the morning.
: You’re disgusting.
: How long are you just gonna stand there for?! We’re trying to get changed!
: Are you? I didn’t notice.
: You’re disgusting.
: You already said that.
: Saying it once didn’t properly convey my feelings on the matter.
: Want to say it a third time just to make sure I know?
: Yes. You’re disgusting.
: Well, umm...on the bright side...at least he didn’t see the two of us naked?
: That’s a plus...right?...
: Hm? Are you that worried about being seen naked, Sana? I think you’ve got an adorable body!
: Lots of guys are into that whole “I’m tiny and precious” sort of thing.
: Uhh...thank you?
: Sensei, can we get the ball rolling soon? I don’t know if I can wait any longer.
: I’m going to need some clarification before I gravely misinterpret what you mean by that.
: She means the beach, dummy! You were supposed to take us there like an hour ago!
: But you’re not even dressed yet.
: I KNOW THAT!
: We were ready but then got tired of waiting for you to wake up so we were showing each other our swimsuits!
: Does Maya’s swimsuit not come with a top?
: Do you not come with a sense of decency?
: I do not.
: You are disgusting.
: Yeah, you’ve mentioned that a few times now.
: Um...maybe it would be best if...Ayane and I talked with you outside the bedroom?
: That way...Ami and Maya could finish getting changed and...not be stared at...
: Yes! What a great idea, Sana! Apparently Sensei needs a reason to not ogle at my friends’ naked bodies!
: In my defense, no one here is completely naked.
: I can’t even see Maya’s-
: One more word and I’ll destroy everything you love.
That’s worrying for several different reasons because I’m pretty sure she could do something like that.
I guess I’ve had my fun, though.
If we really are starting that vacation thing today, I’m sure I’ll be seeing plenty of mildly-exposed girls in the near future.
I shouldn’t spoil all of that fun at once.
: Okay, just hurry up. We wouldn’t want to be late.
: We’re already late!
: Why are you like this?!
That’s a good question, Ami. Why am I like this?
A better question, though, would be “Why is everyone in my life so cute?”
For real. Think about that for a second.
Every single one of my students is adorable. Even their moms are attractive.
What did I do to deserve such a blessed life?
: Heya, Sensei!
: Sorry to keep you waiting. We just had to change back into our normal clothes since we’d attract the prying eyes of so many strangers on the bus in our swimsuits.
: Well...Ayane would...I don’t think many people would pay much attention to me.
: You’ve gotta stop putting yourself down like that, Sana. Confidence is the most attractive quality in a girl.
: You can be a 5/10 but as long as you act like a 10/10 people will get confused and be like “Woah, maybe I do wanna bone her.”
: A five?! E-Even I thought I was higher than that...
: You are! You’re an 11/10! If I liked girls, I’d ask you to marry me. That’s how cute you are.
: I’m so confused...
: That’s fine. The only opinion that really matters belongs to Sensei anyway. And I’m sure he thought you looked super pretty in your swimsuit. Right, Sensei?
Of course
: Absolutely. She was so cute that it should be illegal.
: I-Illegal?! I don’t want to go to jail!
: I’m not even done with[school] yet!
: See what I mean? Bump up that confidence a bit.
: But also don’t get any cuter because I get really jealous whenever Sensei looks at other girls! Hahahahaha!
: Ah! Uhh...I’ll...try...not to?
Eh...
: Ehh...Developing a little more might be good for her...
: Mmn...
: What the fuck is your problem?
: Sure, her boobs are tiny and she’s under 5 feet tall, but she has plenty to offer.
: I...can hear you, Ayane...
: It’s okay...Sensei...I know I’m not really the most...grown-up looking girl...
: Someone like Ayane is much more...suited to your tastes...That’s okay...
: Yes. That may be true. But he should still acknowledge your cuteness, Sana.
: This is a transgression that I simply can not overlook.
: Or at least I will pretend to overlook it and then forget about it after a few minutes because I love him so much.
: This conversation is going places I really didn’t intend.
: Of course Sana’s cute. She’s just...you know. Sana.
: My heart aches...
: Anyway, sorry to keep you guys waiting. Ami normally comes and wakes me up in the morning.
: Not sure why she just...didn’t do that today.
: She probably just got a little distracted when Sana and I showed up out of nowhere.
: We planned on taking my father’s limo there but realized it might be a little more fun to go with everyone on the bus instead.
: How would public transportation ever be more fun than a limo?
: Because you’d be there, of course! Duh!
: Yeah, but couldn’t you have just asked the limo to stop here and take us all instead?
: Hey! Wanna go see how comfy Sensei’s couch is?
: Um...O-Okay?...
Ayane grabs Sana by the wrist and nearly throws her onto the couch.
Within a matter of seconds, I can hear Ami's and Maya’s voices nearing the bedroom door...
: You!
: Me.
: What do you think you’re doing barging into my room like that?
: I barge into your room all the time.
: But today I had friends over! Naked friends!
: Partially-naked. And, if anything, this is your fault for letting your friends get undressed in your room.
: We’re girls! That’s just a thing we do!
I was born the wrong sex.
: Okay, whatever. I’m sorry. But what’s done is done.
: What do you want me to do? Call off the vacation thing?
: You mean the vacation thing you forgot to wake up on time for?
: Yeah, that one.
: Well...no! But you should at least apologize to Maya!
: She’ll just call me disgusting again.
: Probably! But if you ever want to see me again, you’ll do the right thing and apologize!
: What, you’re going to run away now?
: Maybe!
Ami seems adamant about me apologizing and Maya hasn’t even left the bedroom yet.
Maybe she’s more upset about this than I thought?
: Okay, fine. I’ll apologize.
: Good.
: Maya! You can come out now.
Ami goes to join Ayane and Sana on the couch and, within a matter of seconds, Maya emerges from the bedroom.
: ...So about the barging in thing.
: What about it?
: Ecstatic? Thrilled? Aroused?
: All three, actually. But more than that, I’m sorry.
: No you’re not.
: Right now you’re thinking, “Omg. Cute girls. Boobies. Yay!” or something along those lines, aren’t you?
: ...Maybe.
: Ugh. Whatever. Just forget what you saw here.
: I’m going to go talk to my friends now.
: Please don’t follow me.
Soon enough, I am the only person left standing in the living room as Maya, too, joins the rest of the girls on the couch.
: I’m going to follow her.
: What’s everybody else saying? Are they there yet?
: Umm...Well, Molly sent me a picture of a hermit crab, so I’m pretty sure her and Rin are there.
: Futaba, I haven’t heard from. And I don’t have Makoto’s number saved because I want her head to explode.
: Yeah, that sounds about right.
: We’re gonna leave soon, right?
: It would be a waste to start our vacation off halfway through the day when we’re only going to be there for two nights.
: I don’t even know where we’re staying yet.
: Makoto and I took care of that already. She reserved the place and I used my credit card to pay for it.
: We wound up getting two rooms but I hear the place is big, so we can probably all fit in one.
: The second room is just to be safe.
: Why are you winking?
: No reason, my precious best friend.
: I promise you that the second room will only be used if we’re all unable to cram ourselves together in the first one.
: Or we could do the logical thing and have Sensei sleep in the second room.
: I...agree with Maya...
: I’m not really comfortable sleeping in the same room as a boy...
: Don’t listen to them, Sensei. You can sleep in the bed with me.
: You mean the same bed Ami and I will also be sleeping in? Yeah, pass.
: That’s fine. Maya can sleep on the floor and you can sleep between Ami and me.
: Well...I’d feel a little bad about Maya sleeping on the floor, but...
: You’re kidding, right?
: Or we could stick to the original plan and have you...not do that.
: I don’t mind sleeping in the other room with Sensei.
: There are two beds in there so it’s not like we’d be doing anything weird either.
: You’re winking again...
: Sorry. It’s just a reflex at this point.
The five of us decide to get up and go shortly after that.
We walk to the bus stop together and all manage to fit in the same row of two seats.
Ami forces Ayane away from me and takes a spot beside me while the other three sit across from us.
The bus ride to the beach takes about fifteen minutes.
Ayane tells me that Makoto will take me to the cabin/resort/whatever the hell we’re staying at once we all meet up there.
So I guess for now it’s just...managing to survive the trip to the beach?
Welcome to the first special update for Lessons in Love!
Over the next two days, all events will play in succession.
You will not have free time to do as you please, but you’ll still be able to raise your affection with everyone over the course of vacation.
So sit back, relax, and enjoy this mostly-wholesome beach adventure!
